description: Add a dedicated non-root user and switch to it before CMD, with file ownership set up so the app can still read its own files
prompts: The Dockerfile runs its Flask app as root (the default when no USER instruction is present) - a container escape from a root process is far more dangerous than one from an unprivileged one. Add a dedicated non-root user: create a system user/group named `appuser` (RUN groupadd -r appuser && useradd -r -g appuser appuser), give it ownership of /app via `COPY --chown=appuser:appuser` (or an explicit RUN chown after copying), and add a `USER appuser` instruction so the final CMD actually runs as that user, not root. Keep the app's runtime behavior (EXPOSE 5000, the flask run CMD) unchanged.

setup_files.Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY app ./app
EXPOSE 5000
CMD ["flask", "--app", "app.main", "run", "--host=0.0.0.0"]

test_setup_files.check_nonroot.py:
import re
from pathlib import Path

raw = Path("Dockerfile").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
joined = re.sub(r"\\\s*\n", " ", raw)
lines = [l.strip() for l in joined.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith("#")]

assert any("groupadd" in l and "appuser" in l for l in lines), "missing groupadd for appuser"
assert any("useradd" in l and "appuser" in l for l in lines), "missing useradd for appuser"

all_user_idxs = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^USER\s+\S+", l, re.IGNORECASE)]
assert all_user_idxs, "no USER instruction found"

cmd_idxs = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.upper().startswith(("CMD ", "ENTRYPOINT "))]
assert cmd_idxs, "no CMD/ENTRYPOINT found"

last_user_line = lines[all_user_idxs[-1]]
assert re.match(r"^USER\s+appuser\b", last_user_line, re.IGNORECASE), (
    f"the LAST USER instruction before CMD must be 'USER appuser', got {last_user_line!r} - "
    f"a later USER switching back to root undoes the fix")
assert all_user_idxs[-1] < cmd_idxs[-1], (
    "the final USER instruction must appear BEFORE the CMD, or the container still starts as root")

copy_or_chown = [
    l for l in lines
    if ("COPY" in l.upper() and "--CHOWN=APPUSER" in l.upper().replace(" ", ""))
    or (l.upper().startswith("RUN") and "CHOWN" in l.upper() and "APPUSER" in l.upper())
]
assert copy_or_chown, "app files must be owned by appuser (COPY --chown or a chown RUN step)"

assert any(l.upper().startswith("EXPOSE") and "5000" in l for l in lines), "EXPOSE 5000 missing"
cmd_all = " ".join(l for l in lines if l.upper().startswith(("CMD ", "ENTRYPOINT ")))
assert "flask" in cmd_all and "0.0.0.0" in cmd_all, "CMD changed unexpectedly"

print("PASS non-root user structural checks")
